_readme: Edit the values below, then commit the change. No coding needed — you can edit this file right in the GitHub website.
_ntfy_topic_help: This is like a private channel name for your notifications. Make it long and random so a stranger can't guess it and spam you, e.g. 'dave-rocket-launches-8347'. You'll subscribe to this exact name in the ntfy app.
_lead_times_help: How many hours before each launch you want a notification. 72 = 3 days before, 24 = 1 day before, 3 = 3 hours before. Add, remove, or change any of these, e.g. [168, 24, 1] for a week before, a day before, and an hour before.
_rocket_keywords_help: Only launches whose rocket name contains one of these words get notifications. Set to [] (empty) to get notified about every launch on the site, not just SpaceX.
_notify_on_new_launch_added_help: If true, you'll also get a one-time notification whenever a brand new launch first appears on the schedule, in addition to the lead-time reminders.
_notify_on_time_change_help: If true, you'll get notified when a launch you're tracking gets delayed or moved to a new date/time.
